test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is a major disadvantage of an over-inflated tyre?

options.text: Wears out faster at the centre

solution:
The correct answer is __Wears out faster at the centre.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Over-inflated tyres__ lead to uneven wear and tear.
 
• The centre of the tyre wears out faster due to reduced contact with the road.
 
• This reduces the tyre’s lifespan and can compromise safety.
 
• Over-inflation also reduces shock absorption, causing a harsher ride.
 
• While it may slightly reduce rolling resistance, it is not worth the trade-off in safety and comfort.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Under-inflated tyres:**

 
 
• Cause wear on the outer edges of the tyre.
 
• Increase rolling resistance, leading to higher fuel consumption.
 
 
 
• **Proper tyre inflation:**
 
 
• Ensures even wear and longer tyre life.
 
• Improves fuel efficiency and ensures optimal road grip.
 
 
 
• **Maintaining correct tyre pressure:**
 
 
• Check tyre pressure regularly, especially before long trips.
 
• Refer to the vehicle’s manual for recommended tyre pressure values.
